query: UPDATE assistant_actions a SET state='queued',evidence=evidence || jsonb_build_object('refund',jsonb_build_object('refund_id',$4::uuid,'status','creating')),proposal=NULL,review_facts='{}'::jsonb,finished_at=NULL WHERE a.workspace_id=$1 AND a.user_id=$2 AND a.id=$3 AND a.operation_id='orders_refund' AND a.state='dispatching' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_payments p WHERE p.workspace_id=$1 AND p.id=$4 AND p.kind='refund' AND p.created_by=$2)
